record.text: Evidence refs of the form `tool:<ToolName>[#n]` are resolved only against live tool results on the current session branch (getBranch()), via resolveToolEvidence in packages/tools/taskmanage/src/task-manage.ts. Matching is exact on the registered tool name; the index is 1-based and counted per tool name in chronological order. A ref like `tool:mcp__Bash#3` fails with tool_result_unavailable when no branch result has that exact toolName, so the MCP-style prefix must match the registered name exactly. Diagnostics list available refs via sessionEvidenceHints. Alias fallback applies only when the name is absent and maps to a single target.
tags: TaskManage tool evidence refs are exact tool names with current-branch indices
